_comment: AiOS Model Library — single source of truth for all local models across machines.
_comment2: Roles: coder | reviewer | brain | opinion. Tiers: hot (internal SSD) | library (external).

mac-studio-64gb.notes: M2 Ultra, 64 GB unified memory. Flash-Next unusable (GPU OOM + 0.18 tok/s CPU).

models.label: Flash-Next 180B MoE (GGUF IQ4_XS)
models.notes: CPU: 0.18 tok/s. GPU: Metal OOM on 64 GB despite sysctl. Reserve for ≥96 GB machine.

models.label: Qwen3 72B (MLX 4-bit)
models.notes: Best quality upgrade from 27B. Download with: huggingface-cli download mlx-community/Qwen3-72B-4bit --local-dir <library>/Qwen3-72b_40g

models.label: Qwen3.8 27B MoE (MLX 4-bit)
models.notes: Currently at mlx-models/mlx-community/Qwen3.8-27B-4bit. Move to library folder.

models.label: Qwen3 30B-A3B MoE (MLX 4-bit)
models.notes: Fast MoE decode. Good as third-opinion or AiOS brain candidate.

models.label: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct (MLX 4-bit)
models.notes: Primary overnight coder. Code-specialized (5.5T code tokens). Download to ~/Models/.

models.label: Devstral Small 2 (MLX 4-bit)
models.notes: Primary overnight reviewer. Move from mlx-models/mlx-community/ to ~/Models/Devstral/.
